name: Kaltunk
summary: At the heart of the Valley of Trials in Durotar, Kaltunk welcomes young orcs and points them toward their first duties for the Horde.

sections.title: The First Step
sections.body: Kaltunk watches over new arrivals in the Valley of Trials and directs them toward Gornek and the path of discipline. While trainers and elders set trials and hunting rites, the orc overseer gives recruits clear orders so they know where to go.

sections.title: Keeper of the Valley
sections.body: The Valley of Trials was chosen to test the strength and resilience of the youths who walk its canyon floors. Kaltunk brings the same rugged practicality to his work. He offers no grand speeches or coddling, and expects each orc to find a place in the world and serve the warchief.

faq.answer: Kaltunk is an orc overseer in the Valley of Trials. Newly awakened orc adventurers encounter him first, and he points them toward their mentors and the start of their training.

faq.q: What does Kaltunk do for new adventurers?
faq.answer: Kaltunk gives new recruits their initial task: speak with Gornek elsewhere in the valley so their training can begin.
Kaltunk stands near the central training tent and campfire in the secluded Valley of Trials, in southern Durotar.

faq.q: Why is he stationed in the Valley of Trials?
faq.answer: Kaltunk welcomes incoming orc recruits, keeps them organized, and sets them on a path of service to Thrall's Horde.

angles.text: As an orc stepping out into Kalimdor, Kaltunk's gruff instructions are the first words you hear as you begin earning your honor.
As a member of the Horde, you can see how Kaltunk helps maintain order in Durotar's harsh proving grounds.
